description: Reviewed historical-instrument applications for BHARATFIN (decision 2, KEEP_SEPARATE: merged into IndusInd Bank) and HEXAWARE (decision 13, NO_SUCCESSOR). Each creates ONE delisted historical instrument with its own ISIN and alias. BHARATFIN also gets ONE effective-dated relationship; HEXAWARE gets none. No alias onto a successor, no membership transfer. NOT applied by committing this file.

guards.BHARATFIN: merged into IndusInd Bank (INDUSINDBK) on 2019-07-04 at 639:1000; the relationship is AMALGAMATED_INTO, never an alias; no membership transfer
guards.HEXAWARE: owner decision 13 is NO_SUCCESSOR: the 2025 relisting of the same issuer as HEXT (ISIN INE093A01041, a new IPO) is deliberately NOT linked; the old security stays on its own

evidence: NSE Indices press release Dec 2018 (https://www.niftyindices.com/Press_Release/ind_prs14122018.pdf, read in full): BHARATFIN excluded from several indices effective 2018-12-28 (close 2018-12-27) for the scheme of amalgamation of Bharat Financial Inclusion Ltd into IndusInd Bank Ltd. Our exchange files: ISIN INE180K01011, 2016-07-01..2019-07-02. IndusInd Bank announcement: merger effective 2019-07-04, 639 IndusInd : 1000 BFIL.
IndusInd Bank announcement (effective date and ratio not re-read from the primary page)

IndusInd Bank FAQ on the amalgamation (https://www.indusind.bank.in/content/dam/indusind-corporate/corporate-announcement/CompositeSchemeofArrangementMergerofBharatFinancialInclusionLimited/FAQ-on-AmalgamationShareholders.pdf, search excerpt only, 2026-11-15): effective date 2019-07-04 and 639 IndusInd shares for every 1,000 Bharat Financial shares; the document itself was not read in full, so the relationship stays PROVISIONAL
